programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Hua, a clever beauty, teams up with her brother to stage a jewel heist and plans to sell the loot in Singapore. To evade customs, she slips a diamond ring into the pocket of a fellow passenger, Zhang Zhi Xian, only to lose him after landing. Forced to track him down, Hua resorts to a series of clumsy schemes to get close and retrieve the ring.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: The Kid with the Golden Arm
programme.desc: The government hires Yang to escort a cargo of gold to a famine stricken area. The vicious Chi Sha gang, with one of their best fighters, Golden Arm, announce their intention to hijack it by killing one of Yangs employees. As Yang gathers his own team of reputable fighters to protect his cargo, are they strong enough to hold off Golden Arm?

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: Its a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: Martial Club
programme.desc: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other. This is Director Liu Chia Liangs masterpiece and one of the top ten highest grossing movies in 1981.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his masters rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gaos betrayal...

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperors sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: Five Tough Guys
programme.desc: A titular gang of misfits come together to protect a patriotic general from a scheming usurper. To this end, the unlikely heroes act as the generals escorts on a dangerous journey to a distant British consulate, beset by enemies and sinister Japanese interference along the way.

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: Ming marries singer Ling, defying his wealthy father and severing family ties. When Ling becomes pregnant, Mings overwork causes him to lose his sight. To support their home, Ling returns to the stage but Ming leaves to avoid becoming a burden. Encouraged by a friend, Ling performs again, and her song moves Ming to reunite with his wife and child.

programme.title: Brave Archer And His Mate
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong raise the son of his sworn brother Yang Kang and named him Yang Guo. To prevent Yang Guo from taking revenge for his fathers death, Huang Rong bans him from learning martial arts. Yang Guo runs away from home in anger and encounters Ouyang Feng, who teaches him the Toad Stance and accidentally unveils his true identity...

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Godfather of Canton
programme.desc: A docker, Lin Si Hai, accidentally saves Commissioner Cheng who then offers him a position in the police force. Lin is smart and soon rises through the ranks through treachery and corruption, before becoming a gangster.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Changs. On the Changs farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo dies in despair. Devastated by the news, Ying Tai kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperors death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of womens rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: Dirty Ho
programme.desc: Master Wang, who is actually the 11th prince, poses as an antique connoisseur to hide his true identity. When he meets Dirty Ho, a witty con artist, Wang knows he has found the right man to help him untangle a royal succession plot...

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kongs social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: The Battle Wizard
programme.desc: Dali Prince Tuan Yu knows nothing about martial arts, but leaves the palace for the martial arts world. He meets a snake sorceress and his mysterious half-sister. Through various misadventures, Tuan Yu gains invincible power by sucking the cobras blood and swallowing the magic toad, eventually defeating his fathers old rival.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Killer Darts
programme.desc: A group of bandits raided the village where dart master Liu lives and killed his wife. While hunting them down, Lius disciple kills a farmer and his wife when she refuses his advances, leading Liu to adopt their orphaned daughter and raises her with his son. Years later, the daughter meets a man with the bandits and is tricked to go against Liu.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wens brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wens home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The Black Lizard
programme.desc: Young swordsman Lung Fei encounters strange omens portending the death of his fiance. His enquiries with the help of Chief Constable Tieh Hu reveal an astounding story, in this tale of men and women struggling to save their true loves.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Lis daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world boxing champion Fai meets the passionate young fighter Qi in Macau and agrees to train him for an upcoming MMA tournament. As mentor and student push themselves to the limit, Fai rediscovers his love for fighting, regains his passion for life, and learns to cherish the people who matter most.

programme.title: Openthe Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laikas mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: Guided by mysterious dreams, archaeologist Jack discovers he was General Meng Yi in a past life and shared a tragic love with Princess Ok-Soo that spanned a thousand years. When they reunite in Emperor Qins celestial palace, a ruthless tycoon seeks the secret of immortality. Reclaiming his past strength, Jack faces a final battle of destiny.

programme.title: Hail the Judge
programme.desc: A low level magistrate is run out of town for defending a beautiful murder suspect. Through a series of comedic events he ascends to the top rank returns looking for revenge.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find The Sutra of 42 Chapters. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Destinys Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girls heart.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the directors previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killers claims of an evil spell, then it doesnt let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bos magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Chinese immigrant Steelhead struggles to survive in Tokyo alongside fellow migrants before rising to establish a new triad. Just as he secures legal residency and decides to leave the underworld behind, a police crackdown and betrayal by his own brothers force him back into a ruthless battle for survival.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Chengs friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuks pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk an

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: Ten years ago, the ambitious Lord Conqueror sought a prophecy from the Mystic Soothsayer. Told that only two boys named Wind and Cloud could help him dominate the martial world, he took them as disciples. Though his ambition is fulfilled, the prophecy takes an unexpected turn, unleashing a catastrophe that changes the jianghu forever.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: After his fathers death, the impoverished Kwan moves to the provincial capital and works at a textile workshop run by his late fathers friend, retired martial artist Tuen. As a ruthless Manchu warlord exploits martial arts tournaments to expand his criminal influence, Kwan and his allies become entangled in a dangerous fight for justice.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its Cop Shop Babes as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macaus Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the citys casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tais father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai

Soon the foursome is working to undermine each others efforts in order to win the bet.

programme.desc: 雜誌攝影師宋天從胡杏兒因一場意外，失去了雙親也失去了光明，天性愛美和煲電視劇的天從卻未有自暴自棄，男朋友杜正恆張穎康和導盲犬的陪伴令她漸漸重拾自信，她的座右銘更是一句廣告標題愛是無所不能，成為她從傷痛中走出來的力量，誰料這個廣告的創作人甘言重陳豪如今就住在她的隔鄰因沉溺工作令言重失去所有朋友和同事，連徒弟阮婉姚子羚也決定辭職，言重有點迷失，決定放一個悠長假期，重回舊居生活，尋回昔日好朋友余加勁麥長青重回舊地，不單令言重重新出發，更讓他重新認識自己，男友移情別戀令天從再度陷入低潮，幸有言重在旁成為守護天使，二人風馬牛不相及的性格竟擦出了愛火花，以為看見的卻發現盲點，本是瞎眼的卻得見光明.

programme.title: 使徒行者3 Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: 薛家強林峯飾完成三年臥底任務後，回港開設沐足店，繼續收集情報刑事情報科總督察章紀孜黃智雯飾懷疑卓凱苗僑偉飾出獄後投入黑道，對他進行全面監視家強與卓凱捲入器官販賣案，聯同女臥底竇亞希蔡思貝飾及保安局調查官韋作榮馬國明飾，合力搗破涉案集團保安局及後新設安全情報機構，並邀得徐天堂袁偉豪飾加入，接管刑事情報科的工作覃歡喜許紹雄飾逃過一死後，暗中調查某社團的秘密神秘社團原來由長興已故龍頭魏德信的弟弟魏德禮創立，他還設下佈局，對家強卓凱等展開報復.

programme.title: 碧血鹽梟 Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: 緝私營的聶致遠馬浚偉為剿滅鹽梟竇家寨，故意扮作落難秀才博取鹽梟之女竇勝雪楊怡的同情及收留，因而與竇勝雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混亂之中竇勝雪身受重傷並與聶致遠及家人失散，幸得鹽商胡堅郭峰之子胡亭軒黃浩然相救，並暫留胡府待找回雙親及聶致遠，但竇勝雪卻驚見父母的屍首被懸於城樓示眾，而站在樓頂大義凜然地告誡眾人不要販賣私鹽的官員，竟是令自己日夜牽腸掛肚的聶致遠，竇勝雪柔腸寸斷，且對聶致遠有徹骨之恨......胡亭軒為助竇勝雪忘卻不快，安排她在胡府經營的鹽棧工作，而竇勝雪為報答胡亭軒救命之恩，不計勞苦為鹽棧出心出力，那段日子令胡亭軒對竇勝雪由憐生愛，卻礙於惡疾纏身，一直未敢表白，直至竇勝雪的二叔突然現身，暴露了竇勝雪的真正身份，胡亭軒為防家人報官竟向竇勝雪提親......

programme.title: 荷里活有個大老千 I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: 千門八將的龍四鄭則仕飾被華探長文雄湯鎮業飾與大師兄龐峰秦沛飾設局陷害入獄，女友百合張慧儀飾更被文雄搶去五年後，龍四成為地位崇高的製片，有舒奇蔡瀚億飾麥基吳業坤飾兩位得力助手，還有一個剛相認的女兒小雨王子涵飾師弟唐偉黃栢文飾被殺，龍四鎖定其徒弟阿朗馬志威飾所為，二人賭枱上對決小雨向舞蹈老師百合傾訴暗戀新晉導演賀加俊何浩文飾，意外令百合龍四重逢百合偷去文雄的黑金帳簿準備私奔，文雄一怒下趕絕二人龍四押送入獄途中被神秘人劫走，他們正策劃一個捕獸籠，誓把隻手遮天的文雄引入內.

programme.desc: 千門八將的龍四鄭則仕飾被華探長文雄湯鎮業飾與大師兄龐峰秦沛飾設局陷害入獄，女友百合張慧儀飾更被文雄搶去五年後，龍四成為地位崇高的製片，有舒奇蔡瀚億飾麥基吳業坤飾兩位得力助手，還有一個剛相認的女兒小雨王子涵飾師弟唐偉黃栢文飾被殺，龍四鎖定其徒弟阿朗馬志威飾所為，二人賭枱上對決小雨向舞蹈老師百合傾訴暗戀新晉導演賀加俊何浩文飾，意外令百合龍四重逢百合偷去文雄的黑金帳簿準備私奔，文雄一怒下趕絕二人龍四押送入獄途中被神秘人劫走，他們正策劃一個捕獸籠，誓把隻手遮天的文雄引入內.

programme.title: 巨輪 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 喬天生（陳展鵬飾）和羅威信（蕭正楠飾）是同母異父的親兄弟，因為命運令他們不單分開在香港和澳門兩地，更令他們嘗盡劇變歷史中的兩極衝突 母親周玉梅（李司棋飾）帶著小兒子威信在澳門當黑市居民，威信憑著努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮飾）與龍飛（阮兆祥飾）的相助，歷盡艱辛，克服挑戰，最終踏上成功之路獨自在港自食其力的天生卻改走捷徑，聯結黑道古惑仔姜勇（張繼聰飾），與富家女發生關係，令女友卓靜（鍾嘉欣飾）傷心欲絕，最終落得人財兩空 本是唇齒相依的手足情，經歷時代巨輪的洗禮，前境變幻莫測，二人愈走愈遠，但一個信念深植在他們相連的血脈裡，縱然考驗再苦再難，終在一條又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.desc: 喬天生（陳展鵬飾）和羅威信（蕭正楠飾）是同母異父的親兄弟，因為命運令他們不單分開在香港和澳門兩地，更令他們嘗盡劇變歷史中的兩極衝突 母親周玉梅（李司棋飾）帶著小兒子威信在澳門當黑市居民，威信憑著努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮飾）與龍飛（阮兆祥飾）的相助，歷盡艱辛，克服挑戰，最終踏上成功之路獨自在港自食其力的天生卻改走捷徑，聯結黑道古惑仔姜勇（張繼聰飾），與富家女發生關係，令女友卓靜（鍾嘉欣飾）傷心欲絕，最終落得人財兩空 本是唇齒相依的手足情，經歷時代巨輪的洗禮，前境變幻莫測，二人愈走愈遠，但一個信念深植在他們相連的血脈裡，縱然考驗再苦再難，終在一條又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 陪著你走 Every Step You Take
programme.desc: 雜誌攝影師宋天從胡杏兒因一場意外，失去了雙親也失去了光明，天性愛美和煲電視劇的天從卻未有自暴自棄，男朋友杜正恆張穎康和導盲犬的陪伴令她漸漸重拾自信，她的座右銘更是一句廣告標題愛是無所不能，成為她從傷痛中走出來的力量，誰料這個廣告的創作人甘言重陳豪如今就住在她的隔鄰因沉溺工作令言重失去所有朋友和同事，連徒弟阮婉姚子羚也決定辭職，言重有點迷失，決定放一個悠長假期，重回舊居生活，尋回昔日好朋友余加勁麥長青重回舊地，不單令言重重新出發，更讓他重新認識自己，男友移情別戀令天從再度陷入低潮，幸有言重在旁成為守護天使，二人風馬牛不相及的性格竟擦出了愛火花，以為看見的卻發現盲點，本是瞎眼的卻得見光明.

programme.title: 使徒行者3 Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: 薛家強林峯飾完成三年臥底任務後，回港開設沐足店，繼續收集情報刑事情報科總督察章紀孜黃智雯飾懷疑卓凱苗僑偉飾出獄後投入黑道，對他進行全面監視家強與卓凱捲入器官販賣案，聯同女臥底竇亞希蔡思貝飾及保安局調查官韋作榮馬國明飾，合力搗破涉案集團保安局及後新設安全情報機構，並邀得徐天堂袁偉豪飾加入，接管刑事情報科的工作覃歡喜許紹雄飾逃過一死後，暗中調查某社團的秘密神秘社團原來由長興已故龍頭魏德信的弟弟魏德禮創立，他還設下佈局，對家強卓凱等展開報復.

programme.title: 碧血鹽梟 Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: 緝私營的聶致遠馬浚偉為剿滅鹽梟竇家寨，故意扮作落難秀才博取鹽梟之女竇勝雪楊怡的同情及收留，因而與竇勝雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混亂之中竇勝雪身受重傷並與聶致遠及家人失散，幸得鹽商胡堅郭峰之子胡亭軒黃浩然相救，並暫留胡府待找回雙親及聶致遠，但竇勝雪卻驚見父母的屍首被懸於城樓示眾，而站在樓頂大義凜然地告誡眾人不要販賣私鹽的官員，竟是令自己日夜牽腸掛肚的聶致遠，竇勝雪柔腸寸斷，且對聶致遠有徹骨之恨......胡亭軒為助竇勝雪忘卻不快，安排她在胡府經營的鹽棧工作，而竇勝雪為報答胡亭軒救命之恩，不計勞苦為鹽棧出心出力，那段日子令胡亭軒對竇勝雪由憐生愛，卻礙於惡疾纏身，一直未敢表白，直至竇勝雪的二叔突然現身，暴露了竇勝雪的真正身份，胡亭軒為防家人報官竟向竇勝雪提親......

programme.desc: 千門八將的龍四鄭則仕飾被華探長文雄湯鎮業飾與大師兄龐峰秦沛飾設局陷害入獄，女友百合張慧儀飾更被文雄搶去五年後，龍四成為地位崇高的製片，有舒奇蔡瀚億飾麥基吳業坤飾兩位得力助手，還有一個剛相認的女兒小雨王子涵飾師弟唐偉黃栢文飾被殺，龍四鎖定其徒弟阿朗馬志威飾所為，二人賭枱上對決小雨向舞蹈老師百合傾訴暗戀新晉導演賀加俊何浩文飾，意外令百合龍四重逢百合偷去文雄的黑金帳簿準備私奔，文雄一怒下趕絕二人龍四押送入獄途中被神秘人劫走，他們正策劃一個捕獸籠，誓把隻手遮天的文雄引入內.

programme.title: 食為奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天寶王祖藍自小吃盡珍饈百味，各種美食經他一嚐便知龍與鳳，但遭逢家道中落被迫與家僕李衛胡諾言流落街頭，以賣飽糊口，因美食令他結識了賣藝女子紀慕雪萬綺雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女廚神米小魚何雁詩等人，更因緣際會遇上微服出遊的四皇子胤禛黃智賢，二人氣味相投，被引進到宮內的御膳房當御廚，天寶遇上宿敵蔡鶴亭林盛斌，掀起連場龍爭虎鬥；但天寶萬料不到自己竟捲入由八皇子胤禩張繼聰策動的奪嫡之爭中，在劣勢下天寶成了胤禛的福將，連番替他反敗為勝，但一段意外的婚約卻令天寶由一人之下頓貶為喪家狗.

programme.title: 愛情食物鏈 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 從事食品供應的魯佳芳阮小儀樣子平凡，身材矮小，年過三十仍欠缺戀愛經驗，因一次苦瓜事件，幫助餐飲業才俊劉柏業陳智燊渡過難關，令這位高富帥欣賞到佳芳的內在美，並與她漸生情愫，佳芳的鄰居兼好友高貴芬高海寧對此無法釋懷，賣魚出身的貴芬樣貌身材皆屬女神級數，千方百計也未能令柏業過電，卻召來台灣擔仔麵繼承者洪鱻金剛的青睞，洪鱻為親近貴芬不惜自貶身價與佳芳她們同住劏房，貴芬得不到柏業唯有轉戰二叔劉利高鄭子誠，但後來柏業承受不了外界對女友佳芳的負評，二人關係亮起紅燈；當愛情再不是飲水飽，美醜優劣再無標準，男女同時成了獵人與獵物，血肉橫飛的戀愛激戰即將一發不可收拾.

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: O記幹探許浚森陳展鵬飾沈韋力黃智賢飾奉命調查跨國罪案期間，得悉殺虎案幕後黑手魏子樂張頴康飾落網前，曾將神秘訊息發送至暗網，並匯出巨額加密貨幣不久有神秘人策動恐襲，浚森與韋力縱於天才教授唐冠峰方力申飾協助下破案，卻驚覺子樂背後藏着更大陰謀！他們要竭力阻止子樂的同時，也遇到龍頭棍風暴空屋藏白骨重犯越獄等奇案，能否一一掃除險阻？工作上面對的危機升級，感情亦遇挑戰，浚森望跟前女友馬穎思林夏薇飾復合，但困難重重令二人關係出現變數.

programme.title: 大醬園 Dripping Sauce, The
programme.desc: 萬冠園是佛山醬油業百年老字號，大當家萬啟山吳岱融飾與夫人席德容龔慈恩飾堅持傳男不傳女，傳內不傳外的宗旨，可是一宗毒醬油事故，使他不得不答應讓夏小滿朱晨麗飾及葉細么龔嘉欣飾兩女子加入，與其子萬卓楓何廣沛飾成為同期學徒三人與醬園小師傅華歌吳業坤飾建立了複雜的四角關係，又間接揭發了萬家多個秘密，加上卓楓突然被擄走，人心惶惶醬園內，啟山幾個弟弟啟石鄭子誠飾啟川陳嘉輝飾及啟江徐榮飾醞釀分家，醬園外，專員高兆榮袁文傑飾也密謀奪取醬園財產，萬冠園百年基業隨時毀於一旦！.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Kenangan Puan Ainon dan Encik Latiff benar-benar membahagiakan Aisyah yang kini hilang ingatan dan hidup di bawah nama seorang NUR. Rokiah dan Sarip sering datang menjenguk Aisyah di rumah Anim dan Azri, ini membuatkan Aisyah yang hidup dengan nama NUR seperti merasai semula kasih sayang dari kedua ibu bapanya yang sudah meninggal dunia. Aisyah begitu bahagia sehingga dirinya bertemu dengan Haziq. Tanpa sengaja, selepas pulang dari seminar di sebuah kampong, Haziq ternampak akan Aisyah di kawasan sawah padi bersama Amani, Rokiah dan Sarip. Di situ Haziq mengekori Aisyah yang berselisih dengannya tetapi tidak mengenali Haziq. Haziq mengambil keputusan untuk bermalam di kampong itu, dia tidak percaya Aisyah tidak lagi mengenalinya. Haziq begitu yakin wanita yang dijumpainya itu Aisyah. Pada keesokan hari, Haziq datang semula ke sawah padi dan menegur Amani, Haziq bertanya terus akan Aisyah namun jawapan yang diberikan oleh Amani mengecewakan Haziq. Haziq meminta Amani membawanya ke rumah untuk bertemu Aisyah dan di situ Haziq bertemu dengan Anim Azri. Anim dan Azri menceritakan segalanya-galanya tentang Aisyah dan nama NUR itu diberi oleh kerana Aisyah tidak dapat mengingati namanya sendiri. Haziq lega akhirnya dia berjumpa dengan Aisyah, dia meminta izin untuk membawa Aisyah pulang namunh Aisyah menolak keras dan tidak mahu berpisah dengan Rokiah, Sarip, Anim, Azri dan Amani yang member sinar bahagia buat dirinya.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Syarfan mula mengabaikan Antasya. Namun dia bengang dan cemburu apabila melihat Antasya begitu mesra dengan Nazareth. Dia meragui kesetiaan cinta Antasya terhadapnya. Antasya bersabar dengan sikap dingin Syarfan kepadanya dan tabahkan hati melihat Syarfan terlalu prihatin terhadap Talia. Antasya mengizinkan Syarfan mengahwini Talia.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Habsah memarahi anaknya Fatimah kerana berkawan dengan anak Alawiyah Jazlee, tetapi Aishah terus menggalakkan perhubungan Fatimah dengan Jazlee. Jazlan memberitahu ibunya yang dia bersedia untuk menikahi Qasih dan berita gembira ini Alawiyah kongsikan dengan Khadijah. Tetapi malangnya Qasih tidak bersetuju dan terus talipon dan marahkan Jazlan. Beberapa hari kemudian, tanpa disedari yang itu semua adalah lakonan melihatkan ibunya sentiasa dalam kesedihan dan murung, Qasih dengan perasaan tidak mahu menderhaka kepada ibunya, akhirnya menyatakan yang dia bersetuju untuk bernikah dengan Jazlan

programme.desc: Hani Fadzil bersama Jasper Supayah akan menyediakan 2 menu istimewa iaitu Sambal Petai Udang Cucur Jagung.

programme.title: Analisa Anna Lisa
programme.desc: Anna Lisa, seorang suri rumah, menyiasat kematian misteri jirannya melalui podcast jenayah bersama dua wanita lain. Dalam mencari kebenaran, dia berdepan ugutan, pengkhianatan dan kehilangan, namun akhirnya menemui semula tujuan hidupnya.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Kenangan Puan Ainon dan Encik Latiff benar-benar membahagiakan Aisyah yang kini hilang ingatan dan hidup di bawah nama seorang NUR. Rokiah dan Sarip sering datang menjenguk Aisyah di rumah Anim dan Azri, ini membuatkan Aisyah yang hidup dengan nama NUR seperti merasai semula kasih sayang dari kedua ibu bapanya yang sudah meninggal dunia. Aisyah begitu bahagia sehingga dirinya bertemu dengan Haziq. Tanpa sengaja, selepas pulang dari seminar di sebuah kampong, Haziq ternampak akan Aisyah di kawasan sawah padi bersama Amani, Rokiah dan Sarip. Di situ Haziq mengekori Aisyah yang berselisih dengannya tetapi tidak mengenali Haziq. Haziq mengambil keputusan untuk bermalam di kampong itu, dia tidak percaya Aisyah tidak lagi mengenalinya. Haziq begitu yakin wanita yang dijumpainya itu Aisyah. Pada keesokan hari, Haziq datang semula ke sawah padi dan menegur Amani, Haziq bertanya terus akan Aisyah namun jawapan yang diberikan oleh Amani mengecewakan Haziq. Haziq meminta Amani membawanya ke rumah untuk bertemu Aisyah dan di situ Haziq bertemu dengan Anim Azri. Anim dan Azri menceritakan segalanya-galanya tentang Aisyah dan nama NUR itu diberi oleh kerana Aisyah tidak dapat mengingati namanya sendiri. Haziq lega akhirnya dia berjumpa dengan Aisyah, dia meminta izin untuk membawa Aisyah pulang namunh Aisyah menolak keras dan tidak mahu berpisah dengan Rokiah, Sarip, Anim, Azri dan Amani yang member sinar bahagia buat dirinya.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Syarfan mula mengabaikan Antasya. Namun dia bengang dan cemburu apabila melihat Antasya begitu mesra dengan Nazareth. Dia meragui kesetiaan cinta Antasya terhadapnya. Antasya bersabar dengan sikap dingin Syarfan kepadanya dan tabahkan hati melihat Syarfan terlalu prihatin terhadap Talia. Antasya mengizinkan Syarfan mengahwini Talia.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Habsah memarahi anaknya Fatimah kerana berkawan dengan anak Alawiyah Jazlee, tetapi Aishah terus menggalakkan perhubungan Fatimah dengan Jazlee. Jazlan memberitahu ibunya yang dia bersedia untuk menikahi Qasih dan berita gembira ini Alawiyah kongsikan dengan Khadijah. Tetapi malangnya Qasih tidak bersetuju dan terus talipon dan marahkan Jazlan. Beberapa hari kemudian, tanpa disedari yang itu semua adalah lakonan melihatkan ibunya sentiasa dalam kesedihan dan murung, Qasih dengan perasaan tidak mahu menderhaka kepada ibunya, akhirnya menyatakan yang dia bersetuju untuk bernikah dengan Jazlan

programme.title: Rojak
programme.desc: Dihoskan oleh Leaism, beliau akan melakukan aktiviti yang tidak pernah beliau cuba, mencuba makanan baharu, dan berkongsi pengetahuan am. Selain itu, terdapat juga segmen melibatkan respondan luar iaitu Cabaran dan juga Soalan Rawak.

programme.title: Ijab Kabut
programme.desc: Mat dan Khai bersaing untuk membuktikan siapa yang lebih layak untuk Deanna. Deanna pula telah merosakkan majlis pengumuman jantina bayi Athira dan harus mencari jalan untuk menyelamatkan keadaan.

Dan berita ini juga membuatkan Aisyah meroyan dan terus ke rumah Alawiyah untuk meyakinkan Alawiyah menerimanya sebagai menantu dan apabila Jazlan sampai dari Mesir Aisyah terus meluru masuk ke rumah Alawiyah dan sekali lagi meminta Alawiyah menerimanya sebagai menantu bukan Qasih. programme.desc: Trendsetter adalah rancangan mengenai trend fesyen dan gaya hidup. Kini kembali dalam musim terbaru bersama pengacara Zakuan Zainal. Episod kalini menampilkan FIXI dalam segmen Usha Kedai, Gaya Kerjaya Syafiq Azlan dan Bedah Kotak P-23 - Detachable S-S Shirt

programme.title: HURU HARA
programme.desc: Huru hara ini membincangkan tentang dunia hiburan, perjalanan kerjaya tetamu jemputan dan persembahan artis. Artis jemputan pada episod kali ini adalah Bell Ngasri, Kahoe Hon, Syazuwan Hassan dan Mimi Fly.

programme.title: Judika Live in Malaysia 2025 Part 1
programme.desc: Konsert Judika Live in Malaysia 2025 yang berlangsung pada 15 November 2025 di Stadium Hoki Nasional, Bukit Jalil, menyaksikan penyanyi terkenal Indonesia itu memukau ribuan peminat menerusi persembahan bertenaga selama hampir dua jam dengan menyanyikan lebih 20 lagu popular beliau.

programme.title: Ceroboh
programme.desc: Selepas dunia dilanda makhluk asing yang dikenali sebagai Penunggu Langityang mampu mengawal minda manusiaenam rakan berlindung di sebuah bangunan usang. Namun apabila salah seorang daripada mereka terdedah kepada mereka, rasa curiga dan paranoia mula menjangkiti kumpulan itu, membawa ancaman yang lebih membahayakan daripada serangan di luar.

programme.title: Munafik
programme.desc: Adam merupakan seorang pengamal perubatan Islam yang tidak dapat menerima hakikat isterinya sudah tiada di dunia ini. Kemudian, dia bersetuju untuk merawat seorang wanita yang tertekan bernama Maria tetapi perkara aneh dan meresahkan mula berlaku.

programme.title: Hani
programme.desc: Hani ialah seorang pelukis manga junior yang kembali ke Malaysia tetapi menghadapi masalah dengan tugasan terbarunya yang berkaitan dengan seorang patung berhantu.

programme.title: Budak Pendamping
programme.desc: Ia mengisahkan tentang seorang budak yang berumur 16 tahun, bernama Firash. Dibesarkan sebagai seorang anak tunggal di sebuah keluarga yang sentiasa sibuk dengan kerjaya, membuatkan Firash lebih senang bersendiriaan. Disebabkan itu keluarganya membuat keputusan untuk hantarnya ke sebuah kem. Disana Firash bertembung dengan Idlan dan rakannya Khai dan Sahar, serta sebahagian dalam Ahli Majlis Tertinggi Asrama AMTA bagi kem tersebut. Akibat ketidakpuasan mereka terhadap Firash yang kelihatan lembik, badannya menjadi tempat untuk mereka lepaskan kekerasan. Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. Lantas, adakah perjanjian antara Firash dan pendampingnya merupakan ilusi semata - mata ataupun terdapat hutang yang akan dituntut antaranya dengan Tuan Daud?

programme.title: Kanang Anak Langkau
programme.desc: Sebuah filem berdasarkan kisah benar Sarjan Kanang Anak Langkau, seorang pahlawan iban dan pahlawan perang yang paling terkenal di negara ini, yang berjuang dengan berani semasa pemberontakan komunis.

programme.title: Abang Long Fadil 1
programme.desc: Abang Long Fadil, seorang lelaki yang sentiasa berangan bahawa kehidupannya seperti seorang gangster. Tetapi apabila sahabat baiknya, Malik dimasukkan ke penjara, lebih banyak kekacauan berlaku dan angan-angannya mungkin tidak jauh berbeza daripada realiti.

programme.title: Black S2 EP4
programme.desc: Black menolong Sofia menyelamatkan seseorang yang rapat dengan Sofia tapi itu hanya menyebabkan mereka hampir maut. Semuanya tampak ada kaitan dengan runtuhan Pusat Membeli-Belah Seri Setia.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China And America
programme.desc: Berikutan serangan hendap dalam lawatannya ke Amerika, Wong Fei-hung terpisah daripada rakan-rakan pengembaranya dan mengalami kehilangan ingatan.

programme.title: Foreigner
programme.desc: Kisah ahli perniagaan London yang rendah hati Quan, yang masa lalunya yang telah lama terkubur meletus dalam dendam yang didorong oleh dendam apabila satu-satunya orang yang ditinggalkan untuk dicintainya - anak perempuan remajanya - diambil daripadanya dalam tindakan keganasan bermotif politik yang tidak masuk akal . Dalam pencarian tanpa henti untuk identiti pengganas, Quan terpaksa terlibat dalam konflik kucing-dan-tikus dengan seorang pegawai kerajaan Ireland, yang masa lalunya mungkin mengandungi petunjuk tentang identiti pembunuh yang sukar difahami.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP1
programme.desc: Long Samad kemudian menceritakan kisah Zufar dan Rihana. Zufar bertemu dengan Rihana secara tidak sengaja dan tertarik dengan gadis itu. Tanpa mengetahui rahsia besar yang disembunyikan keluarga Rihana, Zufar akhirnya memilih untuk berkahwin dengannya walaupun mendapat tentangan daripada ibunya, Zahrah, dan adiknya, Lia.Antologi mengisahkan Lima pelajar universiti menemui Long Samad Que Haidar, penjaga sebuah rumah terpencil yang menceritakan kisah-kisah seram seantero nusantara.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP2
programme.desc: Nadirah dan Farhan merupakan pasangan suami isteri yang sudah lama mendambakan cahaya mata. Antologi mengisahkan Lima pelajar universiti menemui Long Samad Que Haidar, penjaga sebuah rumah terpencil yang menceritakan kisah-kisah seram seantero nusantara.

programme.title: The Swindlers
programme.desc: Sekumpulan penipu bersatu untuk memburu penipu terkenal yang diketahui mati, di tengah-tengah motif tersembunyi dan penipuan mereka.

programme.desc: Nadirah dan Farhan merupakan pasangan suami isteri yang sudah lama mendambakan cahaya mata. Antologi mengisahkan Lima pelajar universiti menemui Long Samad Que Haidar, penjaga sebuah rumah terpencil yang menceritakan kisah-kisah seram seantero nusantara.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP5
programme.desc: Zacky terkesan dengan kematian adiknya Aeera. Dia menyalahkan Ritz dan Affiyah atas apa yang berlaku. Tindakan Rafeeq cuba membunuh Affiyah tergendala dengan kemunculan seorang jururawat. Affiyah yang terlantar dihospital akhirnya meninggal setelah diganggu dengan mimpi ngeri serta mimpi bertemu arwah ibunya.Ritz bersedih atas pemergian adiknya dan Zacky pula terbaring tidak sedarkan diri menerima berita tentang Affiyah. Rafeeq mula terasa kesal atas perbuatannya terhadap Affiyah selama ini

programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. Lantas, adakah perjanjian antara Firash dan pendampingnya merupakan ilusi semata - mata ataupun terdapat hutang yang akan dituntut antaranya dengan Tuan Daud?

programme.title: Gran Turismo
programme.desc: Berdasarkan kisah benar yang luar biasa, filem ini mengisahkan Jann Mardenborough, seorang remaja yang handal bermain simulator Gran Turismo. Apabila Nissan melancarkan pertandingan mencari bakat baharu, Jann terpilih untuk menyertai kem latihan elit di bawah bimbingan bekas pelumba, Jack Salter. Daripada kerusi gaming ke kokpit kereta lumba sebenar berkelajuan 320 kmj, Jann mesti berdepan tentangan keluarga, persaingan sengit dan bahaya maut di litar lumba. Dia perlu mempertaruhkan nyawa di perlumbaan legenda 24 Hours of Le Mans untuk membuktikan kepada dunia bahawa dia bukan sekadar seorang pemain video game, tetapi seorang pelumba sejati.

programme.title: Chicago Med
programme.desc: Selepas kemalangan kereta, Dr. Natalie Manning mengalami kecederaan otak dan Dr. Halstead dipenuhi rasa bersalah. Kecurigaan timbul apabila Phillip mendakwa dirinya tunang Natalie. Sementara itu, Dr. Connor Rhodes berdepan tragedi peribadi apabila Dr. Ava Bekker membunuh diri selepas mengaku menyebabkan kematian ayahnya. Maggie bergelut dengan diagnosis kanser, Dr. Choi dan April berdepan ujian hubungan, manakala Dr. Charles kembali awal dari bulan madu untuk merawat pesakit yang disyaki menghidap skizofrenia.

programme.title: Trilogi Cinta
programme.desc: Norjinah bekerja sebagai pembantu rumah kepada Razif bagi melarikan diri daripada sikap bapa tirinya, Pak Badar. Razif kemudian berkahwin dengan Norjinah atas amanah arwah isterinya, Salmi, untuk menjaga anak-anak mereka. Walaupun perkahwinan mereka sering digugat fitnah Pak Badar, godaan Norseha, dan pelbagai konflik keluarga, Norjinah tetap tabah mempertahankan rumah tangga dan cintanya bersama Razif.

programme.title: Angin Rindu Sarajevo
programme.desc: Kisah gadis Bosnia cekal berdepan dengan dugaan sanggup berhijrah meninggalkan bumi kelahirannya untuk menuntut ilmu. Malah gadis bernama Natasya itu juga gigih mahu memperjuangkan dan membangunkan anak bangsanya terutama penduduk tempatan supaya berjaya dan membangun seiring dengan perkembangan dunia luar. Begitu pun tanggungjawabnya bukan mudah kerana keadaan di Bosnia Herzegovina bukan mudah untuk seorang wanita terutama anak gadis mendapat pendidikan di luar negara untuk berperanan di negara sendiri.

programme.desc: Mak Jah, seorang guru Al-Quran yang telah menabung dengan Tabung Haji selama 30 tahun demi cita-cita menunaikan haji. Namun sejak tinggal bersama anaknya, Suhaili, dia semakin risau melihat menantunya Borhan yang terlalu taksub mengejar kekayaan. Tanpa pengetahuan keluarga, Borhan menerima rasuah dan akhirnya ditangkap, menyebabkan semua akaunnya dibekukan. Selepas Borhan dibebaskan, Mak Jah jatuh sakit. Dalam keadaan lemah, dia merayu agar Borhan dan Suhaili menggantikannya ke tanah suci, dengan satu permintaan sahajapulanglah dengan membawa air zam-zam untuknya. Shakir tidak bersetuju Abil dikurung, namun tidak mampu mengubah keadaan apabila ibunya terpaksa mendapatkan dadah untuk Abil. Apabila Mak Leha merancang menunaikan umrah, abangnya bersetuju menunaikan ibadah itu bagi menggantikan Abil yang semakin teruk keadaannya.

programme.title: THE WORLD OF LOVE ((爱在世界尽头))

programme.title: Cho Lam His Trip Buddies (周林 他的三兄弟会)
programme.desc: After his One-Stroke-Wear journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series authentic style with another travel program. This time, however, hell be joined by friends, and the main theme will be a series of in-depth revisites along the milestones in Cho-lams life, uncovering the fun and warmth of everyday life. programme.title: Cause Of Death (死亡原因)
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Chi-yan gains Lam Sums approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun Mark Ma. The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yans buddy Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yans career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-kas death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased! (香港汇集全球菜,其独特的菜和精致的菜吸引了富有挑的爱好者! 食物主持人和主持人如Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong,Jessica Liu,Gillian Ng跟上最新的食物新闻和交易,深入了解味道背后的故事. 收集了各种平台的流行餐厅的第一手信息,主持人亲自排列并品尝食物,提供了真实的评论.即使没有餐饮选择的餐厅也很受欢迎.)

programme.title: Vital Lifeline ((最强生命线))
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health. (城市居民往往经历着繁忙的生活和高度压力,这使他们更容易受到健康问题的影响。最强的生命线帮助你解开健康的秘密。首先,该方案在常见的城市疼痛问题上有四大系列,包括头痛、肩部和颈部疼痛、背部疼痛和联合疼痛。每集都邀请医疗专家解释这些病症的原因,以及物理治疗师和锻炼专家进行适当的锻炼。随着东西方医学结合的趋势日益增长,甚至美国游泳冠军迈克尔·菲尔普斯也使用杯式疗法来缓解疼痛。因此,每集都包括传统的中国医学诊断,辅之以针线、杯子和Sanfu草药补丁疗法等疗法,这些疗法在最热的夏季特别合适。此外,中国医药从业人员分享了营养汤的食谱,所有这些都有助于调节和改善你的健康。)

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021 ((天龙八部))
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Cause Of Death (死亡原因)
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sums approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun Mark Ma. The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yans buddy Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yans career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-kas death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased! (新任命的女性法医病理学家程志扬·赫拉·陈博士一直受到Lam Sum Willie Wai博士的启发。自从Chiyan博士还是个孩子以来,她一直渴望加入法医病理学处。然而,她在其上司Lam Sum博士开始新工作后被其上司Lam Sum博士所排挤。Lam Sum和他的前妻Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU高级检查员,不能站在一起。她们的女儿Lam Suet-lui离家出走,她们的道路又再次交叉。Chiyan 得到Lam Suet-lui的认可,她的工作态度是勤奋的,她与警官Ko Chun Mark Ma建立了联系。她们中的三个人逐渐成为精心协调的犯罪破坏三者。在经历了心脏病和失业之后,Chiyans兄弟Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng成为当地新闻记者。她和时髦的记者Tsim Pak-yu Nicolas Yuen从玩耍的对手发展到支持的合作伙伴。正如Chiyan的事业正在进步一样,她听到好朋友死亡的消息。她决心揭露真相并说出死亡的真相。)

programme.title: The Truth Within ((剥茧))
programme.desc: Qi Sizhe becomes Director of Forensic Medicine for the Hecheng Criminal Police Unit, reunites with Han Feng, and investigates the truth behind his girlfriend Yu Feis death from the drug Original Diamond three years earlier. A series of nightclub attacks, cocoon murders, medical-school specimen crimes, insurance frauds, and silencing killings all point to a new narcotic and a drug-manufacturing ring. Qi Sizhe, Han Feng, and their team uncover Professor Wu Yongchang as the mastermind and Yu Feis true killer. Police raid the drug factory, arrest Wu and the traffickers, and close the new Original Diamond case. (齐志哲(Qi Sizhe)成为黑城刑警组法医学主任,与韩峰团圆,调查其女友尤飞三年前因毒品原钻石而死亡的真相。 夜总会的一系列袭击、cocoon谋杀、医疗学校标本犯罪、保险欺诈和静默杀人都指向一个新的麻醉药品和毒品制造圈子。 齐志、韩风及其团队揭发吴永昌教授为主谋和Yu Feis真正的杀手。 警察突袭毒品工厂,逮捕吴和贩毒者,并结束新的原钻石案。)

programme.title: Cho Lam His Trip Buddies (周林 他的三兄弟会)
programme.desc: After his One-Stroke-Wear journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series authentic style with another travel program. This time, however, hell be joined by friends, and the main theme will be a series of in-depth revisites along the milestones in Cho-lams life, uncovering the fun and warmth of everyday life. The filming locations span Fuzhou, Guangxi, and Vancouverthree distinctive places that have held significant meaning for Cho-lam at different stages of his life. Cho-lam walks through the streets and alleys with three groups of travel friends, exploring everything from hometown connections and cultural awakening to the most important aspecthis romantic destinytelling his unique story through travel snippets. (Wong Cho-lam在一丝不苟地前往东川和尚图之后,继续其系列真实的系列风格和另一个旅行计划。然而,这一次,由朋友加入地狱,主题将是沿Cho-lams生活的里程碑进行一系列深入的重新审视,揭示日常生活的乐趣和温暖。拍摄地点横跨福州、广西和温哥华三地,这些地方在Cho-lam的生活的不同阶段对Cho-lam有着重要的意义。Cho-lam与三组旅行朋友在街道和巷子里走过,探索从家乡联系和文化觉醒到最重要的浪漫命运,通过旅行片讲述他的独特故事。)

programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue ((过街英雄))
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing Sammy has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan Priscilla Wong, causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai KK Cheung, Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam. Gold digger Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngais real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan. (柳亮在一次交通事故中不幸失去了左耳,在接受移植手术后,他获得了神秘的老鼠权。良星不断制造假消息以为自己谋利。他与正直的女警察宋海燕王普西利亚(Sung Hoi-yan Pricilla Wong)发生冲突,导致他们两人失业。在她叔叔Ming Kwan-ngai KK KK 张的支持下,贺燕成为私人调查员。梁星被迫帮助慧妍探查她的调查活动,因为他利用神秘的力量去探明Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam女神。金发的Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong作为富有的家族继承人,Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau 和她成为了敌人,受到残酷的骚扰。Mi-fun-fun 原谅徐伟,并主动提出帮助他陷入困境。梁星越来越傲慢,因为他用自己的权力来解决案子。与此同时,Hoi-yyan 突然地发现我本人的心力和心力。)

programme.desc: The Cantonese word gaigui ?? is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. programme.desc: The dating reality show A Date with Goddess is back with a bang, and the second seasons love battlefield is all upgraded! programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small (香港:永远不要太小)
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the citys structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of small spaces. (在时间的流逝和流逝中,描述城市缩影的当地商店越来越少见。然而,它们是城市结构的重要部分,也是香港精神不可替代的体现。铭记这一点,下到土宿主Louis Yuen带领观光员逐商店探索、参观时间充裕的现代商店,横跨日常生活的四个关键领域:服装、食品、住房和交通。他揭示了经营历史的商店、维护历史的困难以及几代人的故事,利用这些有形商店保存无形的记忆并展示小空间的持久美景。)

programme.desc: Thailand expert Hu Huichong once again leads the Tom Yum Family members to introduce the latest travel information in Bangkok, including glamorous massage parlors with perfect photo spots, newly opened shopping malls with sky parks, and buffet restaurants hailed as the pinnacle of Bangkok tourism. The content is truly rich in Thai elements. In addition, Bobo Huang Jingling continues to appear in this episode, giving away plenty of perks. She will accompany Hu Huichong to visit Ayutthaya, Khao Yai, and other areas around Bangkok, recommending popular holiday destinations for locals. Besides unboxing hotels, they will also visit pseudo-Japanese photo spots and hotel-attached childrens playgrounds, guaranteeing an authentic Thai experience. (泰国专家Hu Hu Hu Huichong再次带领Tom Yum家族成员在曼谷介绍最新的旅游信息,包括光景绝佳的按摩院、新开的天空公园购物中心、以曼谷旅游为顶峰的自助餐厅。 内容在泰国确实非常丰富。 此外,博博黄金格尔(Bobo Huang Jingling)继续出现在这一集中,给予大量福利。 她将陪同Hu Hu Huichong访问Ayutthaya、Khao Yai和曼谷的其他地区,推荐当地民众的节日旅游目的地。 除了无包装的旅馆外,他们还将参观假日相点和酒店连锁儿童游乐场,保证泰国真正的体验。)

programme.title: Mystery Files ((苏联神秘档案))
programme.desc: Love is an extremely complex subject, surrounded by numerous environmental factors that can alter our dreams and understanding of romance. These factorsranging from changes in age and the rise of internet culture to the emergence of scams and other seemingly unusual reasonshave led to bizarre, worldview-shattering love stories in society. The TVB Plus live show Mystery Files hosted by Fire Lee, Jinny Ng, and Randal Tsang, invites people from all walks of life, celebrity guests, and relationship experts to discuss each episodes theme. With unique perspectives and thought-provoking questions, they boldly explore emotional dilemmas, while also welcoming viewers to join the conversation and solve problems together through the live chatroom and call-ins. (爱是一个极其复杂的话题,周围环境因素众多,可以改变我们的梦想和对浪漫的理解。 从年龄变化、互联网文化的兴起、骗局和其他看似不寻常的原因等诸多因素导致社会上出现奇特的、充满世界观的爱情故事。 由Fire Lee、Jinny Ng和Randal Tsang主办的TVB+实况节目神秘文件邀请各行各业的人、名人客人和关系专家讨论每个事件的主题。 他们以独特的视角和发人深省的问题,大胆地探索情感困境,同时也欢迎观众通过现场聊天室和来宾参与对话并共同解决问题。)

With a world full of mysteries, the program gathers paranormal news from around the globe, and Chi Yan will travel to South Korea and Taiwan to explore local supernatural phenomena. Real-time interaction with the audience is also a highlight of Spirit Connection, with the team closely following live broadcasts, (你并非孤军奋战的归来者!在第二个赛季,节目再次由鬼王梁西浩王(Ghosts Leung Si Ho)和黄耀英、黄志燕(Wong Yiu Ying Ying)和编辑王志燕(Wong Ying Yeuk)和黄智燕(Tong Chi Yan)共同主持,让观众们更加高兴和惊讶。每集都关注不同的超自然主题,由分享幽灵故事并揭露宗教仪式和行业习俗秘密的重量级客人组成。在充满神秘的世界里,节目汇集了来自全球的超自然新闻,而志燕将前往南韩和台湾探索当地超自然现象。与观众的实时互动也是“精神联系”的亮点,与团队密切跟踪实况广播,)

programme.desc: Venus Online is a vibrant lifestyle and beauty show featuring the latest in makeup, skincare, and fashion. Each episode shares practical tips and fun challenges that inspire confidence and celebrate personal style.

programme.title: Girls Tease
programme.desc: This show focuses on the issues that are most important to urban modern women. It combines current events with discussions of lifes major and minor problems and invites various specialists to address various difficulties.

programme.title: Top Singers
programme.desc: The show Top Singers aims to spotlight outstanding Taiwanese singers and composers, setting a new standard in the industry. Combining elements of competition, variety, and personal stories, the show welcomes participants of all ages.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Show Biz delivers fast-paced coverage of the latest celebrity news, entertainment events and popular culture. Through studio segments, interviews, live reports and highlights, the programme keeps viewers informed about current stars, performances and industry developments.

programme.title: Love, Now
programme.desc: Lan Shi De, who lost his first love in college, reunites with Yang Yi Ru in a foreign land. When he learns she has only six months to live, he decides to marry her and fulfill her dream wedding. Eight days later, she mysteriously disappears, and Shi De vows not to let true love slip away again.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 2 ((倚天屠龙记之圣火雄风))
programme.desc: In this sequel, Zhang Wu Ji successfully rescued the Six Major sects at Dadu. Nevertheless, the quest for the Dragon Sabre continues as Wu Ji and his three girlfriends set sail for Ice Fire Island. After a series of vicious fights, they finally unveil the secret behind the Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre.

programme.title: Social Distancing ((大地 (Social Distancing Version)))
programme.desc: Cherry is a young girl addicted to the internet. After seeing a warning video about an e-ghost on YouTube, she begins to encounter many mysterious incidents, and the e-ghost also takes control of her family. Cherry must face her unbearable past in order to get out of this horrifying paranormal world...

programme.title: Lets Get Rich ((我们一起发))
programme.desc: The Jia family, a group of talented Taiwanese con artists, is recruited by a fraudster to expose a corrupt tech tycoons Ponzi scheme and to steal millions from him through a complex deception plan. (家是一个有才华的台湾骗子,被骗子招募, 揭露了腐败的科技巨头的庞兹计划,)

programme.title: The Sparring Partner ((正义回廊))
programme.desc: Adapted from a sensational 2013 parricide in Hong Kong, a young man partners with his friend to murder and dismember his parents. Pleading not guilty, the defendants play the devil and idiot game, while the defense attorneys turn on each other. Meanwhile, heated debates emerge inside the jury room, where nine jurors grapple with the truth.

programme.title: The Wandering Earth II ((流浪地球2))
programme.desc: In this prequel, humans build enormous engines on the Earths surface to find a new home when the sun is burning out. In the dangerous universe, a group of young people has to step forward once again to fight in the critical battle to save the Earth.

programme.title: One Second (一秒钟)
programme.desc: Directed by renowned director Zhang Yimou, the film is set during the Cultural Revolution, where a common man escapes a labour camp to find a newsreel that captures his daughter for one second in a movie. On the way, he encounters an orphan who also seeks the movie reel. Can the man finally pass the reel to a projectionist and screen the movie?

programme.title: 72 Tenants of Prosperity ((72家租客))
programme.desc: Ha Kung and Shek Kin are sworn brothers, but become sworn enemies in business and every aspect of life after Pinky, the girl they love, marries Ha Kung. It is only when the property owner of both their shops wants to terminate their tenancies forty years later, that they are able to resolve the rivalry. (夏强和石坚是兄弟,但在他们爱的女孩平奇之后,他们成为商业和生活各个方面的死敌。 只有在他们两家商店的房主想在四十年后终止他们的房客时,他们才能解决竞争。)

programme.title: Atonement ((下一个就是你))
programme.desc: Single father Ah Long lives a humble life with his beloved daughter, believing kindness will always be rewarded. However, when she is abducted during a trip to Thailand, his faith shatters. Desperate to find her, he marries a local Chinese woman to remain in the country and hunt down a human trafficking ring, becoming a blood-soaked avenger.

programme.title: Bodyguards And Assassins ((十月围城))
programme.desc: On 15 October 1906, Chinese revolutionary leader Sun Yat Sen returned to Hong Kong to stage another overthrow of the Qing dynasty. Businessman Lee and Chinese Dailys Chief Chan arrange for five bodyguards to protect Mr Sun - these are all extraordinary fighters who are ready and up for fierce battles against the Qing assassination army. (1906年10月15日,中国革命领袖孙森返回香港,再次推翻清朝.商人李和中国日报总监陈安排了五名保卫人来保护孙先生 - - 这些都是非常出色的战士,准备好与清杀军进行激烈的战斗.)

programme.title: Someone Like Me (像我这样的人)
programme.desc: Mui, who lives with cerebral palsy, longs for connection and meets volunteer Kin. As their wounded souls grow closer, she begins to rethink love and her self-worth beyond the limits of her body, discovering the courage to embrace life and intimacy on her own terms.

programme.title: Operation Mekong ((湄公河行动))
programme.desc: After it is discovered that the drugs seized on the Chinese ships had been planted by the henchman of a notorious drug cartel leader named Naw Khar, the governments of Thailand, Laos, Myanmar and China launched a joint task force to apprehend the criminal by sending a band of elite narcotics officers to the Golden Triangle to uncover the truth.

programme.title: The Monkey King 3 ((西游记女儿国))
programme.desc: Monkey King, Pigsy and Sandy escort Monk Tang to retrieve the scriptures and accidentally head into the mysterious Female Kingdom. The Queen falls in love with Monk Tang at first sight, but her advisor orders Monk Tang and his disciples to be executed. As the four attract the appearance of River Spirit, the Female Kingdom is plunged into crisis!

programme.title: Life Hotel ((奇妙酒店：大堂之外的生活))
programme.desc: Once a gangster, Li struggles to find work to pay for his fathers heart surgery. To earn money, he goes undercover to help shut down Life Hotel for a redevelopment project, but gradually forms bonds with its residents. As Li discovers that the hotel serves as a home for the sick, he grapples with his sense of responsibility and empathy.

programme.title: Turns We Take ((杨龙澄))
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident (东北中国的一个味的热餐厅每天都为不同类型的客户服务.其中包括一个甜蜜的年轻夫妇,两个偏执不良的年轻人和一个出租车司机.)

programme.title: Ride On ((怪物猎人物语 RIDE ON))
programme.desc: Master Luo, a washed-up stuntman, trains his beloved horse Red Hare to be a stunt horse. Due to his debts though, Red Hare may be taken away by the debtors. Master Luo has no choice but to seek help from his estranged daughter, and the incident ends up becoming a golden opportunity for them to reconcile. (卢老爷是一个被洗劫的特技演员,他训练他心爱的红兔马成为特技马。 但是,由于他的债务,红兔可能被债务国夺走。 卢老爷别无选择,只能从他离家出走的女儿那里寻求帮助,这一事件最终成为他们和解的良机。)

programme.title: The Sorcerer The White Snake ((白蛇传说))
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snakes true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Honey Money Phony ((“骗骗”喜欢你2))
programme.desc: After falling victim to a romance scam and being left with massive debt, Lin Qinglang teams up with con artist Ouyang Hui to reclaim her stolen money. As they set up an elaborate scheme against the scammers, the pair slowly develop unexpected feelings for each other amid lies, deception and twists of fate. (林清兰与骗子乌阳·胡伊合作,要求她收回被盗的钱.当他们建立了一个精心策划的骗子,夫妇在谎言,欺骗和命运扭曲中慢慢地对彼此产生意想不到的感觉.)

programme.title: Our Crazy Adventures ((那些年，我们一起疯狂的事))
programme.desc: Before graduation, five high school friends - Jia Yi, Kopi, Uncle, Wawa and Ah Di - decide to do something unforgettable together. Chasing dreams, friendship and youthful passion, they take on a seemingly impossible challenge, winning a crucial basketball game that could change their lives and shape their future forever. (毕业前,五个高中朋友Jia Yi、Kopi、Uncle、Wawa和Ah Di决定一起做一件令人难忘的事情。 他们追求梦想、友谊和青春的激情,面对着似乎不可能的挑战,赢得了一场关键的篮球比赛,这可以改变他们的生活,塑造他们永远的未来。)

programme.title: Cold War ((冷战风云录))
programme.desc: A hijacking of a police van occurs when the Police Commissioner is away from Hong Kong. Deputy Commissioner Lee leads a rescue operation code-named Cold War. Fellow Deputy Commissioner Sean moves to take control from Lee as he thinks Lee is emotionally affected by his son being held hostage, but the efforts end up threatening both their reputation. (警方专员离开香港后,便发生劫持警车事件。 李副局长领导了一个代号为冷战的救援行动。 肖恩副局长副局长西恩(Sean)试图控制李(Lee),因为他认为李(Lee)因儿子被扣为人质在情感上受到影响,但他的所作所为最终威胁到他们的声誉。)

programme.title: Burning Stars ((孤星计划))
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai under the shadow of White Terror, agent Li Yi Min is tasked with escorting a key figure to safety. He reunites with former allies to break through deadly traps. Amid the turmoil, a group of idealistic youths join the cause, risking everything to uphold the mission and find courage in a time of chaos.

programme.title: Better Days (更好的日子)
programme.desc: In this Oscar nominee for Best International Feature Film, Nian faces relentless bullying from her peers as she prepares for her college entrance exam. Fate leads her to streetwise punk Bei, but before they can retreat into their own world, both are embroiled in a murder investigation that will change their lives forever.

programme.title: Invincible Swordsman (无敌剑术士)
programme.desc: Longing to leave the martial world behind, Linghu Chong is drawn into a fierce conflict between rival factions. He falls for the enigmatic Dongfang Bubai, whose secret acts of kindness save him. But manipulated by Ren Wo Xing into believing she slaughtered his fellow disciples, Linghu Chong is driven into a tragic, life-or-death showdown. (为了摆脱武术世界,Linghu Chong陷入了敌对派别之间的激烈冲突。 他投身于神秘的Dongfang Bubai,他的秘密善行拯救了他。 但是,任Wo Xing操纵她相信她屠杀了其他门徒,而Linghu Chong却陷入了一场悲剧性的生死战。)

programme.title: Forever Diamonds ((007：金刚钻))
programme.desc: Hua, a clever beauty, teams up with her brother to stage a jewel heist and plans to sell the loot in Singapore. To evade customs, she slips a diamond ring into the pocket of a fellow passenger, Zhang Zhi Xian, only to lose him after landing. Forced to track him down, Hua resorts to a series of clumsy schemes to get close and retrieve the ring.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone ((老夫子))
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags! (加入奇幻小说中的蛋先生,他试图赢得一个丽的女人的心. 随着骑行,他的忠实的助手是大土豆先生,一个坚强的家伙,他永远陷入愚蠢的意外.)

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again ((老夫子奇趣录))
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: The Kid With The Golden Arm ((金臂童))
programme.desc: The government hires Yang to escort a cargo of gold to a famine stricken area. The vicious Chi Sha gang, with one of their best fighters, Golden Arm, announce their intention to hijack it by killing one of Yangs employees. As Yang gathers his own team of reputable fighters to protect his cargo, are they strong enough to hold off Golden Arm? (集团的成员们在集团的团队中,他们会把金臂带到一个受饥荒影响的地区. 恶毒的奇沙帮派,其中一个战斗员,金臂,宣布他们打算通过杀死一个的员工来劫持金枪.)

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase ((钓金龟))
programme.desc: Its a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments. (剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧情: 剧)

programme.title: Martial Club ((武馆))
programme.desc: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other. This is Director Liu Chia Liangs masterpiece and one of the top ten highest grossing movies in 1981.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine ((杨贵妃))
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself. (杨桂飞是唐明黄皇帝最受人爱戴的侍从,她对她非常不满,以至于他把国家留给杨桂飞之兄杨国钟首相管理,总理对军队是腐败和残忍的,使他们造反和危害王位,杨桂飞也卷入其中自杀。)

programme.title: The Master ((大师))
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his masters rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gaos betrayal

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung And The Beauty ((乾隆皇与三姑娘))
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperors sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou. (皇帝隆在苏州遇见了一个著名的妓女,为了尽可能多地和她在一起,他建造了一个直接的地下道进入禁城.皇帝通过这种直接访问突然出现震惊了他的人民,但也是在这个时候他帮助需要的人,并破解了苏州的博业务.)

programme.title: Five Tough Guys ((五大汉))
programme.desc: A titular gang of misfits come together to protect a patriotic general from a scheming usurper. To this end, the unlikely heroes act as the generals escorts on a dangerous journey to a distant British consulate, beset by enemies and sinister Japanese interference along the way. (为了保护一个爱国主义将军免受一个阴谋的掠夺者,一个名为不适合的团队聚集在一起.)

programme.title: Till the End of Time ((直到永远))
programme.desc: Ming marries singer Ling, defying his wealthy father and severing family ties. When Ling becomes pregnant, Mings overwork causes him to lose his sight. To support their home, Ling returns to the stage but Ming leaves to avoid becoming a burden. Encouraged by a friend, Ling performs again, and her song moves Ming to reunite with his wife and child.

programme.title: Brave Archer And His Mate ((神雕侠侣))
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong raise the son of his sworn brother Yang Kang and named him Yang Guo. To prevent Yang Guo from taking revenge for his fathers death, Huang Rong bans him from learning martial arts. Yang Guo runs away from home in anger and encounters Ouyang Feng, who teaches him the Toad Stance and accidentally unveils his true identity

programme.title: Woman Of The Night ((蛇变惊魂夜))
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him. (电影讲述了爱情和痴迷的三个故事.第一部讲述了一个小学生,他有个视觉习惯,他间着两个女同房的女同房人.第二部讲述了一个办公室经理对他的秘书产生了热情.最后一个讲述是一段复杂的家庭戏剧,讲述了一个弱势的父亲迫使他的家人离开他.)

programme.title: Godfather Of Canton ((黄埔滩头))
programme.desc: A docker, Lin Si Hai, accidentally saves Commissioner Cheng who then offers him a position in the police force. Lin is smart and soon rises through the ranks through treachery and corruption, before becoming a gangster. (林西海,一个船员,意外救了成长,然后他提供了警察的职位.林很聪明,很快通过叛国和腐败,)

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake ((寒煙翠))
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Changs. On the Changs farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget. (一位年轻的女孩陈是被离婚的父母送走的。 在长斯农场上,她遇到了他们的两个儿子、最小的女儿和一个年轻的艺术家,并且和他们度过了她永远不会忘记的夏天。)

programme.title: The Love Eterne ((七世夫妻之梁山伯与祝英台))
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo dies in despair. Devastated by the news, Ying Tai kills herself at his grave. (泰伪装为男孩去上学,爱上了同学博.发现她真实身份后,博提出婚约,才知道泰已与另一个男人交婚.被迫分离,博绝望地去世.被消息摧毁,博在他的坟墓上自杀.)

programme.title: Empress Wu ((唐朝禁宫秘史))
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperors death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor. (泽天是唐皇帝14岁的美丽和才华横溢的女神.她在唐皇帝去世后成为修道女,但与新皇帝唐高宗生了两个儿子.皇帝女士要求与她合作,反对夫人,但被设置并推翻了王位,他也杀了她的两个儿子.)

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets ((双镯))
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of womens rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: Dirty Ho ((臭臭和脏脏))
programme.desc: Master Wang, who is actually the 11th prince, poses as an antique connoisseur to hide his true identity. When he meets Dirty Ho, a witty con artist, Wang knows he has found the right man to help him untangle a royal succession plot... (王师父,实际上是第十一位王子,扮演着古董的知识分子,以隐藏他的真实身份.)

programme.title: Hong Kong 73 ((香港'73))
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kongs social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home... (在1973年,香港恒盛指数达到非凡的峰值,)

programme.title: The Battle Wizard ((天龙八部))
programme.desc: Dali Prince Tuan Yu knows nothing about martial arts, but leaves the palace for the martial arts world. He meets a snake sorceress and his mysterious half-sister. Through various misadventures, Tuan Yu gains invincible power by sucking the cobras blood and swallowing the magic toad, eventually defeating his fathers old rival. (达利王子尤对武术没有任何了解,但离开宫殿前往武术世界.他遇到了一个蛇巫婆和他的神秘的半妹妹.通过各种不幸,尤通过吸着子的血和吞下魔术获得了无敌的力量,最终击败了他的父亲的老对手.)

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples ((弟子也疯狂))
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics. (故事围绕着沙olin寺的三个世俗门徒:Fang Shi Yu,Hong Xi Guan和Hu Hui Qian.杰教导他们武术,但他们与同学Wu Qing的频繁竞争激发了竞争.曾经平静的沙olin寺陷入混乱,但即使是修道士也无法避免被他们的恶作剧娱乐.)

programme.title: Killer Darts ((追魂镖))
programme.desc: A group of bandits raided the village where dart master Liu lives and killed his wife. While hunting them down, Lius disciple kills a farmer and his wife when she refuses his advances, leading Liu to adopt their orphaned daughter and raises her with his son. Years later, the daughter meets a man with the bandits and is tricked to go against Liu. (一群强盗袭击了箭师住在村庄,并杀害了他的妻子.在追捕他们时,李斯门徒杀死了一名农民和他的妻子,当她拒绝他的提前,导致收养了他们的孤儿女儿,并和儿子抚养她.多年后,女儿遇到了一个强盗的人,被骗去反对.)

programme.title: Dead End ((归去))
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wens brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wens home and shoots her brother dead. (因在车辆崩后遇到了一个富有女孩文.因爱上了文,但文的兄弟不喜欢他,禁止他的妹妹见到他.他羞辱并打,所以拿着他在街上意外发现的枪到文的家,并射杀了她的兄弟.)

programme.title: The Black Lizard ((黑蜥蜴))
programme.desc: Young swordsman Lung Fei encounters strange omens portending the death of his fianc. His enquiries with the help of Chief Constable Tieh Hu reveal an astounding story, in this tale of men and women struggling to save their true loves.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung ((乾隆皇奇遇记))
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him? (龙皇帝不知名地与他的人民混在一起,了解他们的需要. 在路上,他遇到了许多奇怪的事情,包括被捕和几乎被砍了头.)

programme.title: Jaihind 2
programme.desc: Karate teacher Abhinandan becomes a media sensation after advocating for government takeover of private schools to ensure equal education opportunities, facing threats from school owners.

programme.title: Kaadan
programme.desc: Kaadan, a forest-raised man, vows to protect the jungle and its wildlife when he discovers a politicians plan to destroy it for a township.

programme.title: Nota
programme.desc: After a CM is charged with corruption, he is forced to pass the baton to his son. He with no political experience, finds himself stuck to the chair.

programme.title: Rajini Murugan
programme.desc: Rajini Murugan, an unemployed youth, falls in love with Karthika, his cousin. But Karthikas father opposes the match.

programme.title: Maaman
programme.desc: An uncle and nephew navigate their strained bond and family dynamics through challenging circumstances that test their connection.

programme.title: Rathnam
programme.desc: Rathnam, a henchman for MLA Panner Selvam, rescues a girl during her interview trip to Vellore. As he becomes her protector, he questions how long he can shield her from danger.

programme.title: Yaanai
programme.desc: In Ramnad, PRV juggles life with his two wives and kids while facing blame from another family for his brothers death. Tensions rise as their stories intertwine.

programme.title: Sethupathi
programme.desc: Sethupathi, a tough police officer, investigates the murder of an inspector. His findings lead to the arrest of Vathiyar, an influential man in Madurai, but put his life, career and family at risk.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Jawaan

programme.title: Karnan
programme.desc: Karnan, a fearless village youth, must fight for the rights of the conservative people of his village, due to the torture given by a police officer.

programme.title: Asvins
programme.desc: A bunch of YouTubers accidentally unleash a 1500-year-old evil from the dark realm, causing chaos in the human world. Now, they must band together to stop it!

programme.title: Thiruttu Payale 2
programme.desc: An honest police officer, under orders from a senior official, records conversations of elite professionals. While on duty, he discovers an online sociopath and decides to reveal his identity.

programme.title: Mapla Singam
programme.desc: Amidst the rivalry of two castes in a village, a leaders daughter falls in love with a boy from the rival caste. Things take a turn when her cousin Anbu falls in love with the boys sister.

programme.title: Bhaskar Oru Rascal
programme.desc: Two kids, each from a single-parent home, team up to bring their moms and dads together, hoping to create the happy, complete family theyve always wanted.

programme.title: Thondan
programme.desc: Narayanan, a politicians son, assaults Vishnu when his brother dies in his ambulance. Later, he makes Vishnus life miserable by bribing the local police officers and government officials.

programme.title: Tuck Jagadish
programme.desc: Bhudevipuram has a long history of families warring over ancestral property. However, when its headmans family falls into the same trap, his younger son decides to break the villages age-old legacy.

programme.title: Honey Bunny And The Secret Sun Palace
programme.desc: A hilarious animal chase comedy about the secret life and adventures of a dog, a parrot and twin bobcats living with Ms Katkar

programme.title: Sab Jholmaal Hai
programme.desc: A hilarious animal chase comedy about the secret life and adventures of a dog, a parrot and twin bobcats living with Ms Katkar.

programme.title: Sab Jholmaal Hai
programme.desc: A hilarious animal chase comedy about the secret life and adventures of a dog, a parrot and twin bobcats living with Ms Katkar.

programme.title: Paap O Meter
programme.desc: Adding a twist to ghost comedies, three ghosts in Bhootlok are assigned with the job to scare those on earth who stray onto the path of wrong behavior.

programme.title: Paap O Meter
